name: Starter — Read a Page in Your Browser with Your AI Agent
summary: Opens the example.com sample page in your own browser, reads its title and text, and has your AI agent say in two sentences what the page is.
description: First-run starter: no input and no API key. browser.read opens https://example.com in a new tab of the browser bound to this profile (the MonoAgent extension), reads its title and visible text and closes the tab; it follows Agent browser permissions (Settings), so a level of off refuses it. A local AI agent (agent.ask, runtime auto) then says what the page is in two sentences. Run with: workflow templates run starter_browser_read.
